name: icecubes
build: xcodebuild build -project IceCubesApp.xcodeproj -scheme IceCubesApp -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath "$DERIVED_DATA" -resultBundlePath "$RESULT_BUNDLE" -skipMacroValidation -skipPackagePluginValidation CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO COMPILER_INDEX_STORE_ENABLE=NO
